scope: All 251 exact-lock registry packages, including build-only and target-specific dependencies; original source notices and selected copyright/license comment blocks; pinned Rust toolchain notices compared across six actual native audits; separately preserved Microsoft build-product/runtime license sources and actual native linkage review. Project MIT does not relicense third-party components.

source_method.notice_collection: License, licence, copying, notice, copyright, unlicense and authors files, plus files under licenses/licences directories. Original bytes are preserved. README license claims are not substituted for license text.
source_method.cached_archive_verification: Every current locked registry archive matched Cargo.lock SHA-256. Retained archive-sourced notice slices were checked against their member bytes; new package notices were read from locked archives without extraction. Repository supplements remain separately identified.
source_method.supplemental_review: Two locked registry archives were SHA-256 verified and read without extraction. Missing published license texts were supplemented from exact crate VCS commits; their repository provenance is separate from archive membership. Complete MIT text already in r-efi AUTHORS was reclassified. JSONschema root workspace inheritance and identical same-commit cached sibling text were verified.
source_method.source_header_review: Read checksum-verified locked archives and preserved 913 distinct per-package copyright/permission/disclaimer comment blocks in 54 packages, including vendored SQLite, AWS-LC, ring and target-specific sources. Exact source-file hashes, byte offsets and original comment bytes are recorded. This supplements the root and nested license texts rather than replacing them.
